skill.name: voice-agent-expert
skill.description: Troubleshooting reference and helper scripts for local LiveKit and Letta voice agent development.
skill.summary: Debug local LiveKit and Letta voice agent setup, routing, tokens, and duplicate process failures.
skill.author: EGAdams

security_audit.summary: The skill appears intended for local LiveKit and Letta debugging, not covert exfiltration. Several findings are confirmed because helper scripts read .env files, handle API secrets, spawn shell commands, and start local services with hardcoded paths. Many markdown backtick and localhost URL findings are false positives, but the package needs hardening before broad marketplace distribution.

remediation.suggestion: Replace author-specific paths with configurable options and ask before reading any .env file.

remediation.issue: Shell command execution and broad process control
remediation.suggestion: Use subprocess argument arrays, avoid shell=True, and require confirmation before killing processes.

remediation.issue: LiveKit bound to all network interfaces
remediation.suggestion: Bind development services to localhost by default and document firewall requirements for other bindings.

remediation.issue: Generated LiveKit token is printed to terminal output
remediation.suggestion: Label the token as sensitive, keep its lifetime short, and avoid writing it to logs.

remediation.issue: Temporary PID, lock, and log files use predictable paths
remediation.suggestion: Use safer runtime directories, validate ownership, and avoid manual deletion except after confirmation.

semantic_findings.title: Broad Process Termination Instructions
semantic_findings.description: The reset guidance tells users to kill LiveKit and voice-agent processes before restarting services. Broad process matching can disrupt unrelated local work if run without confirmation.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: Both cited sections contain process-kill and restart guidance for local services. The commands are operationally plausible and not merely scanner artifacts.

semantic_findings.title: Connection Token Printed to Terminal

semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The code directly creates a JWT and prints it under a token label. The behavior is intentional, but the token is still sensitive.

content.value_statement: Voice agent failures are hard to diagnose when audio, WebRTC, tokens, and process state interact. This skill gives focused checks, workflows, and helper scripts for LiveKit and Letta debugging.
actual_capabilities: Explains START versus DEV mode behavior for local voice testing.
Lists common LiveKit, Letta, WebRTC, token, and duplicate-process failures.
Provides checks for local ports, processes, logs, and service status.
Includes scripts for diagnostics, connection token creation, and interactive startup.
Documents duplicate prevention using PID and lock files.
limitations: Uses hardcoded absolute paths from the original author workstation.
Helper scripts expect Linux commands, LiveKit, Letta, and specific Python packages.
Reads .env files and handles API secrets during token generation.
Does not provide production deployment hardening or key rotation guidance.

use_cases.title: Fix Local Voice Chat Setup
use_cases.description: Diagnose why a local LiveKit and Letta voice session fails to connect or respond.

use_cases.title: Debug Audio Cutoffs
use_cases.description: Trace intermittent audio failures to duplicate workers, stale rooms, or wrong agent mode.

use_cases.title: Prepare Support Runbooks
use_cases.description: Turn repeated LiveKit and Letta failures into repeatable checks and escalation steps.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose a Connection Failure
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner troubleshooting for a failed local voice session.
prompt_templates.prompt: My LiveKit and Letta voice agent does not connect. Ask for the error, then guide me through the safest checks first.

prompt_templates.title: Choose the Correct Agent Mode
prompt_templates.scenario: Compare START and DEV mode for local testing.
prompt_templates.prompt: Explain whether I should use START mode or DEV mode for local voice chat, and list the symptoms of choosing the wrong mode.

prompt_templates.title: Investigate Duplicate Workers
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate debugging for audio cutoffs and stale sessions.
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me determine whether duplicate voice-agent workers or stale LiveKit rooms are causing audio cutoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Safer Startup Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced hardening of the startup and token workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my local LiveKit and Letta startup workflow for security risks, secret handling, and safer process management.

output_examples.input: My voice agent joins the room but never responds.
output: Probable cause: duplicate voice-agent workers or the wrong LiveKit hook.
Confirm that only one worker is active and that local testing uses DEV mode.
Check logs for the routing marker that proves Letta is receiving messages.

output_examples.input: The playground says my token is invalid.
output: Generate a fresh LiveKit token because tokens expire after several hours.
Confirm the LiveKit URL matches the server endpoint used by the browser.
Treat the token as sensitive and avoid sharing logs that contain it.

output_examples.input: Audio cuts out after a few seconds.
output: Check for duplicate voice-agent workers before changing model or audio settings.
Restart the worker cleanly after stopping stale processes and clearing stale rooms.
Verify that the active worker is the one receiving current logs.

best_practices: Review every command before running it against local services or shell startup files.
Move hardcoded paths into configuration before sharing this workflow across machines.
Treat generated LiveKit tokens and .env contents as sensitive credentials.
anti_patterns: Do not run broad process-kill commands without confirming the matching processes.
Do not bind local development services to all interfaces without network controls.
Do not paste generated tokens or .env-derived output into public issue reports.

faq.question: What systems does this skill target?
faq.answer: It targets local LiveKit and Letta voice agent development and troubleshooting.

faq.question: Does this skill run commands automatically?
faq.answer: It includes scripts and command guidance. Users should review commands before execution.

faq.question: Can it generate LiveKit tokens?
faq.answer: Yes. The token script reads LiveKit credentials and prints a connection token.

faq.question: Is it ready for production deployment?
faq.answer: No. It is a local debugging reference and lacks production hardening guidance.

faq.question: Why do duplicate processes matter?
faq.answer: Duplicate workers can compete for the same audio stream and create timeouts or cutoffs.

faq.question: Why does the audit flag risk?
faq.answer: The package reads .env files, handles API secrets, starts processes, and uses hardcoded paths.
